fixture: Fresh private PostgreSQL stack, three control-plane replicas and six fake CLI workers with sixteen slots each. Shared development host; all other Garrison test/load jobs stopped.
settings: RequestHistory.Enabled=true throughout both measured arms; only RequestHistory.CaptureNodeProtocol changes false to true. Two seconds convergence plus five seconds warmup, thirty seconds at concurrency 16 per arm. Seed 42 for both harness runs.
interpretation: Disabling successful node-protocol capture removes associated header/history database work. This short single-pair measurement is not a statistically established production throughput or latency improvement. Whole-server SQL and header-insert counts come from the first replica and are estimates; exact completed-scope run SQL excludes HTTP request history.
